I need 1 Wheat to build a settlement on Node 9, which is a 3:1 port I've already reached with my road. Bob has 1 Sheep and 2 Wood, and Charlie has 3 Wood. Since Charlie is out of wheat and Bob is my primary rival (and likely wouldn't trade wheat even if he had it, given our history), I cannot acquire the wheat through trading this turn. I don't have enough resources to trade with the bank (4:1) or buy a development card. Therefore, the only logical move is to end my turn and hope for a wheat roll or a better trading opportunity next turn.
